infoPlist.NSAlarmKitUsageDescription: Used to ring reminders as system alarms that break through silent mode.
infoPlist.NSSiriUsageDescription: Lets you add a task to dundundun by voice, including from the Action Button, without opening the app.

plugins.remindersPermission: Lets dundundun move tasks out of the Reminders app and into your Inbox, so anything you dictate to Siri ends up here.
plugins.calendarPermission: Lets dundundun see what's already on a day — the calendars you pick, including a Google account added on this device — so it can tell how much of the day is free. It only adds events to a calendar you pick yourself in Settings, for deadlines and planned meals you turn on; it changes nothing else.

plugins.contactsPermission: Lets dundundun fill in one person you pick from your contacts, so you don't have to type their name, number and birthday. It reads only the contacts you search for, one at a time, and never copies your address book.

plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: Lets dundundun check today's weather where you are, so a rule you've set up (like sunscreen on a sunny day) can add its task. It only reads your location once a day when this is turned on, and never in the background.

plugins.faceIDPermission: Lets dundundun ask for Face ID before it opens, so an unlocked phone doesn't hand over your task list.
Lets dundundun ask for Face ID before it opens, so an unlocked phone doesn't hand over your task list.

plugins.photosPermission: Lets dundundun read a recipe out of a photo you've already taken, so a cookbook page you snapped becomes a recipe instead of something to retype.
plugins.cameraPermission: Lets dundundun read what you point the camera at: a recipe off a cookbook page or a clipping, a store receipt, or the barcode on a grocery item as you unpack it.
